title: PHP 7.3.26 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.3.26. This is a security release.

All PHP 7.3 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 7.3.26 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
